packages.title: Removing a project closes its page; delete and Share say what's true
brief: Three regressions from b5 round 1 (P13 and P15). P13 added a Compartir / `Miembros · N` button on every owned project's page (home_screen.dart:326-363). P15 added the delete item on Projects ⋮ and the messages after delete or leave.

UX-476 (R1C-1, S3): delete or leave lands on a ghost project page. Today, in `_run` (list_sharing_screen.dart:107-111), delete and leave call `Navigator.pop(context)` once and then `showFeedback(messenger, done)`. When the sharing screen was opened from the project page, that single pop lands on `HomeScreen(listId)` of a project that no longer exists. Its title falls back to `Proyecto` (home_screen.dart:264-268), and the empty state (:450-463) says `Añade una tarea a este proyecto…` under the `Proyecto eliminado` message. Fix it with one mechanism, the push result. (1) In `_run`, on delete or leave, pop with a result: `Navigator.pop(context, true)`. (2) In home_screen.dart, the Compartir / Miembros button (:346-352) pushes `MaterialPageRoute<void>`. Make it `MaterialPageRoute<bool>`, await the push, and if the result is `true` and the page is still mounted, pop the project page too. The user lands on whatever was under it: Projects, a group page or Calendar. GroupScreen pops with null, so group projects don't change. (3) The message (`Proyecto eliminado` or `Has salido de {name}`) must be visible on the screen the user lands on. If showing it from the sharing screen before the second pop makes it vanish or flicker with the closing page, return the message instead of `true` and let the project page call `showFeedback` after its own pop. Either way, the message is shown once. (4) Projects ⋮ → Compartir (task_lists_screen.dart:366-373) already lands on Projects after one pop. Leave it as it is: the new result is simply ignored there. Don't add a second mechanism, such as HomeScreen watching `taskListsProvider` for its own project disappearing.

UX-477 (R1C-2, S2): deleting a project that isn't shared still warns `…para todas las personas`. `deleteListHelp` is used for every project, at task_lists_screen.dart:97-104 (`_delete`) and at list_sharing_screen.dart:374-378 (the owner's delete button). Add a key `deleteListPrivateHelp` with a `{name}` placeholder: EN `Delete {name} with all its tasks, notes and files? This can’t be undone.` / ES `¿Eliminar «{name}» con todas sus tareas, notas y archivos? No se puede deshacer.` / CA `Vols suprimir «{name}» amb totes les tasques, notes i fitxers? No es pot desfer.` Choose it with `list.shared`: shared projects keep `deleteListHelp`, and the others get `deleteListPrivateHelp(list.name)`. On the sharing screen, the button label follows the same flag: `deleteListForEveryone` only when shared, `deleteList` otherwise. Today it always reads `Eliminar el proyecto para todos` (:392). Read `shared` from `taskListsProvider` for `widget.listId`, the same `TaskListInfo.shared` the Projects ⋮ uses (:345-348), so both doors use the same words. If that project isn't in the provider, use the shared wording, which is the cautious choice.

UX-479 (R1C-4, S2): Projects ⋮ says `Compartir` to people who can't share. The item (task_lists_screen.dart:330-334) shows for any signed-in account. An editor or viewer then finds only `Tu rol` and `Salir del proyecto`, and a non-admin group member finds a group page with no way to invite. Keep the item for every signed-in account, because it is where non-owners see the members and leave. Label it `shareProject` (`Compartir`) only when `list.canManage`, which means the owner of a personal project or a group admin (task_list_info.dart:47). Otherwise label it with the existing key `people`: EN `Members` / ES `Miembros` / CA `Membres`. This matches the project page's `Miembros · N`. No new keys.

Don't touch: the project page's empty state and its `Proyecto` title fallback, GroupScreen's own delete and leave flows (the reviewer noted that deleting an empty group closes the group page with no message, which isn't part of this package), Groups' `Revocar invitación` (P27), the `sharingProblem` feminine pronouns (pre-existing, not this package), and P72's Calendar inset.
acceptance: Widget test (UX-476): in Spanish, signed in as the owner of the unshared synced project `Compras`, open Projects → Compras → Compartir → Eliminar proyecto, then confirm, with the server's DELETE succeeding. Projects is on screen, no HomeScreen with Compras' listId is left in the widget tree, and `Proyecto eliminado` is visible.

Widget test (UX-476): in Spanish, as an editor of the shared project `Casa`, open Casa's page → `Miembros · 2` → Salir del proyecto, then confirm. The project page is gone, and `Has salido de Casa` is visible on the screen below.
Widget test (UX-476): open Projects ⋮ → Compartir → delete, then confirm. Projects is still on screen (the app didn't pop one screen too many) and shows `Proyecto eliminado`.

Widget test (UX-477): in Spanish, deleting the unshared project `Compras` from Projects ⋮ shows `¿Eliminar «Compras» con todas sus tareas, notas y archivos? No se puede deshacer.`, and no text contains `para todas`. A shared project's confirmation still shows `deleteListHelp`.

Widget test (UX-477): on the sharing screen of an unshared owned project, in Spanish, the delete button reads `Eliminar proyecto` and its confirmation uses the new text. For a shared project, the button reads `Eliminar el proyecto para todos`.

Widget test (UX-479): in Spanish, Projects ⋮ reads `Miembros` (not `Compartir`) for a shared project where the account is an editor, and for a group project where the account isn't a group admin. It reads `Compartir` for the account's own personal project and for a group project where the account is a group admin.
deviceChecks: On a phone, open a project you own, tap Compartir → Eliminar proyecto and confirm. You land on Projects (or Calendar) with `Proyecto eliminado`, and Back doesn't return to an empty `Proyecto` page.

packages.title: Join dialog stays open while joining; a wrong code stays put
brief: Two regressions from P14 (b5 round 1). P14 created invitation_cards.dart: Calendar's invitation card and one join dialog for projects and groups.

UX-478 (R1C-3, S2): tapping Unirme shows no progress, and a wrong code is lost. In `openInvitation` (invitation_cards.dart:67-211), the dialog pops with the code as soon as Unirme validates. Then `respond` and `refreshAfterInvitation` (a full `loadTasks()`) run with nothing on screen until the project opens. Tapping the card again does nothing (`_responding`). Any error goes to a snackbar after the dialog has closed, so the pasted code is gone. Change it as follows.

1. Send from inside the dialog. Turn the dialog body into a small stateful widget, or a StatefulBuilder, that runs the accept request itself. When Unirme validates: replace Unirme's label with a 20 dp `CircularProgressIndicator` (strokeWidth 2), and keep the button's semantic label `joinInvitation` so TalkBack still says Unirme. Disable Rechazar, Cancelar and the code field. Block Back and taps outside the dialog (`barrierDismissible: false` plus `PopScope(canPop: !sending)`).

2. The wait covers both `respond` and `refreshAfterInvitation`, so the project is loaded before the person lands on it. Once `respond` has succeeded, close the dialog and call `showJoined` even if the refresh throws: the person did join. Keep the account-switch check. If the account changed while sending, close the dialog and do nothing else.

3. On failure, the dialog stays open, the field keeps the code, and the error shows as the field's `errorText` (the field already has `errorMaxLines: 3`), not as a snackbar. The error clears when the person edits the code. A wrong-code error is one where the server message contains `current invitation code`: `Ask the list owner for the current invitation code.` (Backend/core/list_views.py:268) or `Ask a group administrator for the current invitation code.` (group_views.py:279). For it, show a new key `invitationCodeWrong`: EN `Ask the person who invited you for the current code.` / ES `Pide a quien te invitó el código actual.` / CA `Demana el codi actual a qui t’ha convidat.` The reviewer asked for this line for groups, where today the text wrongly says `Pide al propietario del proyecto…`. A project's inviter is its owner, so the same line is true for both kinds, and this dialog uses it for both: one message, no branch. To detect that error, expose the reason that `requestProblemText` already computes (request_locale.dart:24-38), for example with a small `sharingProblemReason(Object error)` that returns `'code'`. Don't compare translated strings. Every other error shows `requestProblemText(strings, error)` under the field, as before.

4. Keep `_responding` as the guard against double responses, and reset it in `finally`. Keep the keys `accept-invitation-code`, `decline-invitation` and `confirm-decline`. Keep the existing behaviour of Decline, Cancelar and the empty-code validator (`invitationCodeRequired`).

UX-480 (R1C-5, S1): (a) Rechazar's confirmation (invitation_cards.dart:164-168) is a plain FilledButton, while every other destructive confirmation in this run is red. Give it the style `groupConfirm(destructive: true)` uses (groups_screen.dart:104-108): `backgroundColor: colorScheme.error`, `foregroundColor: colorScheme.onError`. Keep its key, its label `decline` and its dialog text. (b) In `sharingProblem`, change only the `memberLimit` branch, so it uses the new action name `Anular invitación`. EN `This project supports up to 20 members and 20 pending invitations. Remove someone or cancel an invitation first.` / ES `Este proyecto admite hasta 20 miembros y 20 invitaciones pendientes. Primero elimina a alguien o anula una invitación.` / CA `Aquest projecte admet fins a 20 membres i 20 invitacions pendents. Primer elimina algú o anul·la una invitació.`

Don't touch: Groups' `Revocar invitación` (P27); the invitation review screen and its link flow (P14, which passed); the `sharingProblem.code` text used outside this dialog; the inviter's name (UX-326, cause server-side); and the Decline network wait, which isn't in this finding.
acceptance: Widget test (UX-478): in Spanish, with a pending project invitation to `Compras`, tap Calendar's card → Ver, paste a 20-character code, and tap Unirme while `respond` takes 2 s. During the wait the join dialog is still on screen with a CircularProgressIndicator inside it, Rechazar and Cancelar are disabled, and Back doesn't close it.

Widget test (UX-478): with a group invitation, `respond` fails with `Ask a group administrator for the current invitation code.` The dialog stays open, the field still holds the pasted code, `Pide a quien te invitó el código actual.` shows under the field, and no SnackBar appears. A project invitation failing with `Ask the list owner for the current invitation code.` shows the same line.
Widget test (UX-478): when `respond` fails with a connection error, the dialog stays open with the code kept, and the error text shows inside the dialog.
Widget test (UX-478): when `respond` succeeds, the dialog closes, and the project page shows `Te has unido a Compras` (unchanged landing).
Widget test (UX-480): after Rechazar, the confirm button `confirm-decline` has the theme's `colorScheme.error` as its background.

grep (UX-480): the `memberLimit` branch reads `anula una invitación` (ES), `cancel an invitation` (EN) and `anul·la una invitació` (CA), and no catalog's `memberLimit` branch contains `revoca` or `revoke`.
deviceChecks: With a second account on a slow connection, open Calendar's card → Ver, paste the code and tap Unirme. The spinner shows in the dialog until the project opens. A wrong code leaves the dialog open with the code and `Pide a quien te invitó el código actual.`

packages.title: Settings: blocked reminders say so; one sheet style; time help without 'capturas'
brief: Two regressions from P18 (b5 round 1) and one finding from P18 that was only partly fixed.

UX-481 (R1D-1, S2): the Recordatorios row says Activados when the phone blocks alerts. Its new subtitle (settings_screen.dart:28-36) reads only `reminders.enabled` and `leadMinutes`. With the notification permission revoked, or never granted on Android 13+, Ajustes still says `Activados · 10 minutos antes`. Only the Recordatorios screen shows `notificationPermissionOff` (notification_settings_screen.dart:203-211). Make SettingsScreen a ConsumerStatefulWidget with `WidgetsBindingObserver`, as NotificationSettingsScreen does (:40-53). Read `ref.read(reminderAccessProvider).capability()` on init, on `AppLifecycleState.resumed`, and after returning from `/notifications` (await the `pushNamed`, then read again). When reminders are enabled and `capability.allowed == false`, the subtitle is a row with `Icons.notifications_off_outlined` (16-18 dp) and a new key `remindersBlocked`: EN `Blocked by your phone` / ES `Bloqueados por el teléfono` / CA `Bloquejats pel telèfon`. Both the icon and the text use `colorScheme.error`; the icon is there so colour isn't the only signal. Until the first answer arrives, show today's subtitle. Off the phone, `capability()` already reports `allowed: true`, so nothing changes there. Don't show the exact-alarm state here; the Recordatorios screen explains it. Don't request the permission or call `reconcile` from Ajustes.

UX-482 (R1D-2, S1): Ajustes rows 2 and 3 open sheets that look and close differently. Apariencia (settings_screen.dart:95-152) uses full-width radio rows and says `Como el teléfono`. Idioma (language_selector.dart:96-151) uses tinted rounded cards with a check icon, a close X, and `Usar idioma del teléfono`. Rebuild `_LanguageSheet` on the Apariencia pattern. The heading is `language` in `headlineSmall` with padding `fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 8)`. Below it, a `RadioGroup<String>` with `groupValue: preferences.language` and `onChanged` calling `_choose`, holding one `RadioListTile<String>` per code (`AppLanguages.system` first, then `AppLanguages.displayCodes`). Give each row `contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24)` and `key: ValueKey('language-$code')`, and disable the rows while `_saving`. The system row keeps the phone's language name as its subtitle (`automatic`). Remove the close IconButton, because the drag handle and the scrim already close the sheet. Also remove the tinted `Material` cards, the check icon and the `Semantics(selected:)` wrapper, since RadioListTile announces the selection. Keep the sheet scrollable at large text, using the 85% max height or a SingleChildScrollView as Apariencia does. Rename `languageAutomatic` to EN `Same as phone` / ES `Como el teléfono` / CA `Com el telèfon`, and `languageFollowing` to EN `Same as phone · {language}` / ES `Como el teléfono · {language}` / CA `Com el telèfon · {language}`.

UX-422 (S1, second attempt): Hora y región still uses the capture jargon. Last attempt, P18 did the rest of the finding: the title, the removed language picker, `Zona horaria`, the city names, `Como el teléfono`, and deleting `languageHelp`. But its brief only asked it to update `regionalFormatsHelp`, so the time-zone help `timezoneHelp` (regional_settings_screen.dart:105) was left as it was. In Spanish that text is 31 words and says `nuevas capturas` twice. `timezoneFallback` (:112) says `Las nuevas capturas usarán…`. Replace `timezoneHelp` with one line: EN `New tasks use this time zone to read dates.` / ES `Las tareas nuevas usan esta zona para entender las fechas.` / CA `Les tasques noves fan servir aquest fus horari per entendre les dates.` Change `timezoneFallback` to EN `The device timezone is unavailable. New tasks will use {zone}.` / ES `No se puede obtener la zona del dispositivo. Las tareas nuevas usarán {zone}.` / CA `El fus horari del dispositiu no està disponible. Les tasques noves utilitzaran {zone}.` The capture sheet also uses `timezoneFallback` (voice_task_screen.dart:1573), and the new wording reads right there too. Don't change that file.

Don't touch: the Apariencia sheet (it is the pattern), the Recordatorios screen, the TaskFlow Pro row's subtitle, the duplicate legacy time-zone ids (`US/*`, `Canada/*`; noted, not planned), English-only city names in the zone search, and App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md.
acceptance: Widget test (UX-481): in Spanish, with reminder preferences on (lead 10) and a fake ReminderAccess reporting `supported: true` and `capability()` = `allowed: false, exact: true`, the Ajustes Recordatorios row shows `Bloqueados por el teléfono` with a notifications-off icon, both in `colorScheme.error`, and doesn't show `Activados`. With `allowed: true` it shows `Activados · 10 minutos antes`. With preferences off and `allowed: false` it shows `Desactivados`.

Widget test (UX-481): with Ajustes open and reminders on, switch the fake to `allowed: false` and send `AppLifecycleState.resumed`. The subtitle changes to `Bloqueados por el teléfono` without leaving the screen.

Widget test (UX-482): in Spanish, the Idioma sheet contains RadioListTile rows `Como el teléfono`, `Español`, `Català` and `English`, and has no close button. The Apariencia sheet also contains RadioListTiles and `Como el teléfono`. With the language set to follow the phone, the Idioma row's subtitle reads `Como el teléfono · Español`.
Widget test (UX-482): in Catalan at 2× text on 320×568, the Idioma sheet opens with no overflow, and every row can be scrolled into view and selected.

Widget test (UX-422): Hora y región in Spanish shows `Las tareas nuevas usan esta zona para entender las fechas.`, and no visible text contains `captura`. With a fallback zone, the banner reads `No se puede obtener la zona del dispositivo. Las tareas nuevas usarán …`.
grep (UX-422): `timezoneHelp` and `timezoneFallback` contain no `captura` in app_es.arb or app_ca.arb, and no `capture` in app_en.arb.
deviceChecks: Android 13+, reminders on: revoke TaskFlow's notification permission in the phone's settings and return to Ajustes. The row reads `Bloqueados por el teléfono` with its icon. Allow the permission again and return: it reads `Activados · …`.

skipped.reason: Not re-planned: all of the app-side fix is verified (help text, `Sesión iniciada como`, `Ahora no` keeps the link, Calendar's card prefills the code). What's left, the inviter's name, is cause server-side: the invitation payload has no `invited_by_name` (Backend/core/list_views.py:33-35, group_views.py:52-54). Showing it in the app first needs that server change. It stays open in the ledger.
